frequency_question: How often do high-complexity defense technology transfers achieve operational domestic production within a condensed window under structural wartime friction?
membership_rule: Includes state-level programs attempting to domesticate complex Western missile or precision-guided munition manufacturing during an active conflict since 1950. Excludes simple small arms or non-guided munitions.

cases.name: Ukraine Neptune missile domestic production scaling (2018-2021)
Iran Noor/Qader cruise missile reverse-engineering and production (2000s)

coverage_note: 6 named cases; represents major documented historical precedents of complex missile localization.
known_gaps: Classified or highly covert transfers that lack open-source verification in defense literature.
skeleton: 6 historical crisis-driven or wartime guided-weapon domestication attempts meeting strict criteria.
multiplier: 5 hits out of 6 documented attempts under severe structural/wartime friction.
validity_reason: Technology transfer dynamics and industrial base acceleration techniques remain bounded by similar engineering and supply chain constraints over decade-long horizons.
